title: Page structure drawn in depth
blurb: Sections on the faces of a cube, a <nav> along a moving ribbon, an article cut at its <hr> elements into slices at different depths, a <header> that folds away on scroll, <details> as a drawer cabinet and an <aside> that swings on a string. The buttons and links inside are pressed where they are drawn.
question: Can a canvas draw the structural elements of a page (sections, nav, header, details, aside) in pieces and in depth, with the controls inside them still pressed where they are drawn?
result: Yes, with one extra step for an element shown in several pieces. An element has one hit region, so the page moves it to the piece under the pointer on pointerdown, with a draw at alpha 0 made outside the paint event.
